These two 2024 disclosures collectively cover the subject matter of the single 2023 disclosure regarding equity award assumption.

comparisons.peer_summary: Time-based RSUs are awards granted to employees, directors, or consultants that obligate the Company to issue common stock upon satisfaction of vesting terms.
comparisons.comparison: Both Broadcom and AMD disclose the mechanics of Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) awards for employees. Broadcom’s disclosure specifically addresses the assumption and conversion of VMware RSUs into Broadcom common stock RSUs as part of an acquisition, stating that it 'assumed all outstanding VMware RSU awards... held by continuing employees' and that 'The assumed awards were converted into RSU awards for shares of Broadcom common stock.' Similarly, AMD discloses the general structure of its time-based RSUs, noting they are 'awards that can be granted to any employee... and that obligate the Company to issue a specific number of shares of the Company's common stock in the future if the vesting terms and conditions are satisfied.' While Broadcom’s disclosure is driven by a specific M&A integration event converting external awards, and AMD’s is a general policy statement on grant obligations, both confirm the issuance of common stock upon vesting for employee RSUs.

sentences.text: We assumed all outstanding VMware RSU awards and performance stock unit ("PSU") awards held by continuing employees.
The assumed awards were converted into RSU awards for shares of Broadcom common stock.

Time-based RSUs are awards that can be granted to any employee, director or consultant and that obligate the Company to issue a specific number of shares of the Company's common stock in the future if the vesting terms and conditions are satisfied.
